_comment: Per-repo exceptions for a structural-budget hook (structural-sensor) that some contributors run in Claude Code; they win over that hook's global budgets. These three modules were already over its 'standard' tier (400 lines) on 2026-10-25 at 641142d, so no fix could touch them. Each limit is the size measured then plus about 3% on lines and one more function or import. Lower a limit when a module shrinks; splitting them is a separate refactor that is not scheduled yet.
